name: wasm4pm-monorepo
description: High-performance process mining monorepo with WASM acceleration

scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:coverage --workspaces --if-present && cd wasm4pm && npm run test:coverage
scripts.release:full: npm run release:forbidden && npm run release:algorithm-reachability && npm run release:algorithm-behavior && npm run release:verify-algorithm-behavior && npm run examples:gate && npm run prepublish:pack-smoke && npm run release:certificate && tsx scripts/release/verify-certificate-authenticity.ts
scripts.build:all: npm run build --workspace @wasm4pm/contracts && npm run build --workspace @wasm4pm/config && npm run build --workspace @wasm4pm/observability && npm run build --workspace @wasm4pm/ml && npm run build --workspace @wasm4pm/planner && npm run build:all --workspace @wasm4pm/core && npm run build --workspace wasm4pm && npm run build --workspace @wasm4pm/swarm && npm run build --workspace @wasm4pm/testing && npm run build --workspace @wasm4pm/engine && npm run build --workspace @wasm4pm/agents && npm run build --workspace @wasm4pm/cognition && npm run build --workspace @wasm4pm/cli && npm run build --workspaces --if-present
scripts.dev: npm run build:engine && npm run build:cli
scripts.ci:test: npm run tps:check && npm run lint && npm run test
scripts.generate:algorithms: unrdf sync --config unrdf.toml --rule algorithm-registry && npm run build --workspace @wasm4pm/templates
scripts.generate:prediction-tasks: unrdf sync --config unrdf.toml --rule prediction-tasks && npm run build --workspace @wasm4pm/templates
scripts.docs:check: npm run docs:lint && npm run docs:link-check
